Package com.privatechain.network

package com.privatechain.network
Peer-to-peer networking layer for the private-blockchain library — built on Netty 4.2 TCP with NDJSON message framing (ADR-001).

Four sub-packages form the networking stack:

  • com.privatechain.network.peer — peer lifecycle management: connection, heartbeat, and pruning.
  • com.privatechain.network.gossip — transaction gossip and block broadcast to connected peers.
  • com.privatechain.network.sync — chain synchronization on startup and fork resolution.
  • com.privatechain.network.rpc — Netty server/client bootstrap and the NDJSON message codec.

This module depends on blockchain-access so that AllowlistManager can gate every inbound message before any application-layer processing occurs (NFR-SEC-04).

Transport note: The current implementation uses plain TCP with NDJSON framing. A migration to gRPC/TLS is tracked in the post-1.0 backlog as T-B02; see docs/decisions/ADR-001-transport.md for the rationale.

    Description
    com.privatechain.network.gossip
    Transaction gossip and block broadcast — propagates newly submitted transactions and mined blocks to connected peers (FR-NET-02, FR-NET-03).
    com.privatechain.network.peer
    Peer lifecycle management — maintains the list of connected peers, runs heartbeat checks, and prunes unresponsive connections (FR-NET-01, FR-NET-07).
    com.privatechain.network.rpc
    Netty TCP server, client, and NDJSON message codec — the transport layer of the P2P networking stack (FR-NET-01, ADR-001).
    com.privatechain.network.sync
    Chain synchronization and fork resolution — brings a node's local chain up to date with the network on startup and after a network partition (FR-NET-04, FR-NET-05).
